<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Stonewall](/Feats.aspx?ID=4404) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Dwarf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=54" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 45

**Frequency**
once per day

**Trigger**
An enemy or hazard’s effect hits you or you fail a Fortitude save against one

</column>

---

The strength of stone overcomes you so strongly that it replaces your stout body. You become [petrified](/Conditions.aspx?ID=30) until the end of the current turn. You don't take any damage from the triggering effect or any other ill effects that couldn't affect stone.
name: Stonewall
